packs.name: UniProt curated human variants
packs.description: Literature-curated human protein substitutions, source categories, and disease or sample labels linked by rsID.
packs.attribution: UniProt Consortium, UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot humsavar. Converted to indexed rsID context; original protein feature identifiers, substitutions and source categories retained. Missing rsID rows are omitted and no genomic allele mapping is invented. No endorsement is implied.
packs.coverage: Every supplied humsavar row with a valid dbSNP rsID, including benign and uncertain categories; rows without rsIDs cannot be matched and are counted in provenance. Protein substitutions and disease/sample labels are reference context only: an rsID alone does not confirm the source protein substitution in a user's DNA.
